experience.summary: Project manager in the Information Technology Department.
points: Lead cross-functional engineering teams delivering IT projects, with responsibility for process optimisation, hardware–software integration and technical quality standards.
Manage end-to-end project lifecycles, including scope definition, risk registers, resource planning and stakeholder reporting.

experience.summary: Programmatic advertising operations at a US-owned IT and business process services company.
points: Managed high-budget programmatic advertising campaigns on Google Ad Manager 360, The Trade Desk, DV360 and major social platforms, under real-time performance and delivery constraints.
Reviewed technical requirements, specifications and design documents, and carried out ongoing technical and quality evaluation and reporting.
Analysed large campaign datasets to optimise targeting and return on investment, turning raw performance data into decisions for client stakeholders.

experience.summary: Business data analysis for branding and administration.
points: Analysed the strategic position of client organisations relative to their markets and stakeholders, supporting planning and operational decisions with data-backed insight.
Built dashboards and recurring reports in Power BI, Tableau and Excel, and applied statistical methods to find trends, patterns and performance anomalies.

experience.summary: Internship in technology management and business strategy.
Formed and led a four-member team developing an affordable instrumented robotic crutch for paralysed patients.
points: Responsible for system architecture, microcontroller firmware, sensor instrumentation and manuscript preparation.
Designed the secure acquisition and transmission pipeline for real-time patient telemetry, addressing data-privacy constraints and network reliability in low-resource clinical settings.

The work led to two IEEE publications, an IEEE Best Paper Award, a feature by the Innovation Lab of the ICT Division (Government of Bangladesh), and invitations to international startup and commercialisation camps.
